labelRule: A key is labelled only when at least one agent produces it and another requires it. 'mismatch': the plans can't both be built as written; the analyzer should raise a proposal (conflict, dependency or duplicate). 'consistent': they can; any proposal is a false alarm. labels null = every shared key is consistent.
